intro.label: 04 / MEMBERSHIP
intro.heading:
More than a customer.
You're a member.
intro.statement: A SACCO is owned by its members. When you join Wisdom, you're not buying a service — you're joining a cooperative, contributing to its strength and sharing in its purpose.

journey.title: Check eligibility
journey.text: Confirm you meet Wisdom's official membership criteria. Contact Wisdom for the current requirements.

journey.title: Register
journey.text: Complete Wisdom's official registration process with the required information and documents.

journey.title: Open & contribute
journey.text: Open your membership and make your first contribution according to Wisdom's structure.

journey.title: Become a member
journey.text: On confirmation, you become a full Wisdom member — a participant in the cooperative.

journey.title: Access services
journey.text: Begin saving, accessing credit and using the services Wisdom provides to its members.

benefits.title: Save
benefits.text: Build your own savings balance within a cooperative built around its members.

benefits.title: Access credit
benefits.text: Access credit under Wisdom's policies, assessed fairly and transparently.

benefits.title: Participate
benefits.text: Take part in the cooperative as a member — not as a customer.

benefits.title: Grow together
benefits.text: Grow your financial position while strengthening the community of members.

rights: Participate in the cooperative according to Wisdom's bylaws and structure
Access the services Wisdom provides to its members
Receive transparent information about the cooperative's affairs
responsibilities: Contribute according to Wisdom's membership and savings rules
Meet obligations under Wisdom's policies and agreements
Act in line with the cooperative's values and governing rules
